relationship_description: Amado Espino is the father of Amado Espino III, both of whom have served as governors of Pangasinan, continuing the Espino political dynasty.
Multiple individuals named Amado Espino have held political office in Pangasinan, indicating sibling or close family relationships within the Espino dynasty.
Amado Espino III succeeded Amado Espino Jr. as governor of Pangasinan, demonstrating a direct succession within the Espino family.
Members of the Espino family have supported each other's political campaigns and held various positions in Pangasinan, reinforcing their dynasty's influence.
